#!/bin/sh
sudo cscli machines list
sudo -E cscli machines list
sudo -u charon cscli machines list
su-exec charon cscli machines list
env CHARON_X=1 cscli machines list
env -i PATH=/bin cscli machines list
nohup cscli hub update &
command cscli machines list
command -p cscli machines list
exec cscli machines list
xargs cscli machines delete
xargs -I {} cscli bouncers delete {}
echo ok && sudo cscli bouncers list
run_interruptible sudo cscli hub upgrade
timeout 60 sudo cscli hub update
>/dev/null cscli machines list
2>&1 cscli machines list
x=$(sudo cscli machines list)
